row.text: Write up quiet hours for notices as a design page.

Sent back document: Quiet hours for notices, revision 2
Section: How it works
Passage: Notices that arrive wait until 9:00
Why 9:00? I start at 8, and on Fridays I want the digest at 7:30 so I can clear it before standup.
Revise the page at /work/slots/slot-3/.armada/documents/quiet-hours.html and write it again.
9:00 is the work start in Settings. I can tie quiet hours to your own work start instead, so they end at 8:00 for you.

Sent back document: Quiet hours for notices, revision 2
Section: How it works
Passage: A failed check still interrupts.
Yes, tie it to my work start. And should a failed check on a branch wake me? I only care about main.
Revise the page at /work/slots/slot-3/.armada/documents/quiet-hours.html and write it again.
No: a failed check on a branch can wait for the digest. Only one on main stops other Jobs. Revision 3 has both changes; the page you are reading keeps your place until you show it.
